messages.setup_required_text:
Game coordinates ain't charted yet, cap'n.
Please enter yer bearings.
messages.game_dir_required: Game port directory be required, arrr.
messages.game_dir_invalid: Game port directory be invalid, ye scurvy dog.
messages.game_dir_not_detected: Can't spot th' Mewgenics port from here.
messages.exe_not_found: Mewgenics.exe not spotted in th' selected port.
messages.launch_failed:
Failed to set sail with Mewgenics:
{error}
messages.permission_denied_modlist:
Access denied: Can't write to th' ship's log.
Make sure th' hold has proper access.
messages.proton_warning_text:
Ye be runnin' on Linux with a Windows .exe (Proton).

Mods outside th' game bay may not work proper-like.
'Tis recommended to keep mods in th' game hold on Linux/Steam Deck.

Sail on anyway?
messages.no_mods_text: No mods be aboard. Recruit some crew first.
messages.launch_options_instructions:
Copy these launch orders and paste 'em in Steam:
Right-click game → Properties → Launch Options

Note: On Linux/Proton/Steam Deck, keep mods in th' game bay fer best sailin'.
messages.export_bat_instructions:
Th' launch orders have been scribed. To use with Steam:

1. Right-click Mewgenics in yer Steam fleet
2. Select Properties → Launch Options
3. Paste th' followin' orders:
messages.export_bat_note:
Note: Th' scroll contains all yer current mod cargo. Re-export if ye change cargo or riggin'.

If DLL riggin' be enabled, Mewtator.exe and configuration charts be included fer standalone operation.
messages.circular_dependency_auto_sort: Arrr, circular dependencies be detected. Some provisions may not be satisfied.
messages.circular_dependency_requirement: A circular dependency be tangled among enabled crew: {mods}. No valid load order can satisfy these provisions.
messages.dll_injection_prompt:
⚠ SECURITY WARNIN': DLL cargo can execute any orders with full ship authority. Only enable DLL cargo from trusted ports!

This cargo contains DLL files. Would ye like to enable DLL mod cargo?

Mewtator will create a manifest that Mewjector (external DLL chainloader) can read. Ye can change this in Riggin' & Sails > Launch Orders later.
messages.dll_injection_chainloader_warning: ⚠ WARNIN': chainloader.ini not spotted in yer game bay. Ye need to install Mewjector (DLL chainloader) fer DLL cargo to work.
messages.dll_cleanup_nothing: No DLL manifest found in chainloader riggin'.
messages.dll_cleanup_confirm:
This'll clear th' DLL manifest from chainloader riggin'.

Continue?
messages.dll_cleanup_success: DLL manifest has been cleared from chainloader riggin'.
messages.mod_already_exists: A mod hold named '{name}' already exists. Replace it with this ZIP cargo?
messages.invalid_mod_zip: That file ain't valid ZIP cargo.
messages.import_modlist_missing:
Loaded {imported} mods into th' manifest.
{missing} mods be missin' from yer cargo hold.
messages.theme_change_failed: Could not change th' ship's colors: {error}
messages.proton_or_steam_linux_runtime_not_detect: Shiver me timbers, thar be trouble with yer ship's Steam Engine or Wine Hold
messages.proton_missing_compatdata_error:
Thar be no Mewgenics save data (Wine Hold compatdata).

Make sure ye have launched th' game through Steam at least once, so this data be initialized.
messages.copy_launch_options_advice:
If Mewtator's launch button be givin' ye trouble, try an alternative launch procedure:
1. Use 'Launch Orders & Export' from th' File menu
2. Paste 'em in Steam: Right-click Mewgenics → Properties → Launch Options
3. Launch th' game from Steam
messages.stop_game_text:
Some treasure may remain unplundered.
(Cap'n Steven may be furious...)

about.title: About This Vessel
about.subtitle: Mewgenics Mod Quartermaster
about.description: Mewtator be a crew-made mod quartermaster fer Mewgenics, built to make installin’, managin’, organizin’, and usin’ mods simple and convenient!
about.disclaimer: Mewtator be NOT an official tool, nor be it affiliated with or endorsed by the game's developers. Each mod remains the handiwork of its own author, arrr!
about.credit_project: animeowdan - Lead developer/captain o’ creation, Code swabbie
about.credit_tim: Pseudonym_Tim - UI/UX, Code swabbie, Linux support
about.credit_polymeric: polymeric - Additional code swabbin’, Linux support
about.credit_game: Special thanks be to Edmund McMillen and Tyler Glaiel fer creatin’ such an amazin’ game!
about.credit_intro: Custom game intro crafted by Sham & CVS, arrr!

controls.title: Helm & Shortcuts
controls.subtitle: A quick chart fer Mewtator's keyboard an' mouse orders.
controls.launch_game: Set sail with the currently enabled mods.
controls.toggle_selected: Enable or disable the chosen mod.
controls.move_up: Move the chosen enabled mod up one berth in the load order.
controls.move_down: Move the chosen enabled mod down one berth in the load order.
controls.move_top: Move the chosen enabled mod to the bow of the load order.
controls.move_bottom: Move the chosen enabled mod to the stern of the load order.
controls.delete_mod: Send the chosen mod overboard after confirmatin'.
controls.select_mod: Choose a mod an' show its particulars in the preview pane.
controls.toggle_row: Enable or disable the clicked mod row.
controls.reorder_buttons: Move the chosen enabled mod one berth in the load order.
controls.focus_hint: Mod-manifest keyboard orders work while the mod list has keyboard focus. Load-order orders affect enabled mods only.
